summary: Backend regression after DEFAULT_LOCATIONS expansion (10 -> 30) fully passed. All 20 pytest cases green (100%). Verified location count exactly 30, all 10 legacy IDs and all 20 expected new IDs present (28 distinct countries), required schema fields on every location, simulate tick (x3) keeps NPC location_ids valid, Sophie moves successfully to new dubai_mall location, POST /api/reset rebuilds world to 30 locations + 3 NPCs, and regression of health/world/world-pause/logs/translations(fr,en)/objectives/hobbies/stripe.prices all OK. Backend startup log confirms idempotent upsert: '[startup] Locations seeded/upserted. Total: 30'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1414 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (routes/locations.py, routes/characters.py, routes/stripe.py, services/simulate.py, data/defaults.py).

GET /api/locations only seeds via insert_one in the legacy code path (if collection empty) when the startup upsert hadn't run; since the new startup upsert handles seeding idempotently this fallback is dead code and should be removed for clarity.
Stripe webhook handler at /api/stripe/webhook has signature verification commented out (line ~1308). Acceptable for sandbox but must be enabled before production.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests used existing DEFAULT_LOCATIONS / DEFAULT_NPCS seeded by backend startup. The reset test re-creates seed data via /api/reset, which is idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL comes from frontend/.env -> EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run tests with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_locations_expansion.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml . The DEFAULT_LOCATIONS list now has 30 entries spanning 28 countries; new IDs and full schema enforced. Startup event upserts locations on every boot — note this means manual edits to existing location docs in Mongo will be overwritten on restart, which is intentional but worth flagging if E1 wants user-editable locations later.
